name: clean-yard-equipment
about: A parked tractor at a fuel island at night with a direct call to apply. It names no pay and no life outside the cab, so it leads with a plain call (straight talk) — or, read by what is seen first, with the truck itself (equipment first): both are accepted.

output.summary: A recruiting ad asking Class A over-the-road drivers to apply, shown over a white day-cab-less tractor parked at a wet fuel island at night.
